idiom: revient sur le devant de la scène

anchor.semantic_hook: Returning to the front of the stage is staged as bringing each forgotten subject from the rear curtains onto the downstage edge nearest the audience.
anchor.setting: An empty theater contains a proscenium stage, closed rear curtains, prop carts, footlights, and rows of vacant seats. The narrow downstage strip projects hundreds of meters into the auditorium while every other part of the theater retains normal proportions. This impossibly elongated front edge is the theater's sole surreal feature.
anchor.absurd_element: a narrow downstage strip projecting hundreds of meters into the auditorium

inserts.action: wheels a heat-cracked globe and shrinking ice models out from the rear curtain, then pushes them firmly onto the extended downstage edge

variations.scene_adjust: a heat-cracked globe, shrinking ice models, and a dial thermometer occupy the returning prop cart

inserts.action: strides from the rear curtain with an electric guitar, raises one arm triumphantly, and plants a fresh record sleeve at the front edge

variations.scene_adjust: an electric guitar, a drum kit, a keyboard, and an unmarked record sleeve form an eighties rock display

inserts.action: steps confidently onto the front strip in very wide trousers and swings the broad fabric outward with both hands

variations.scene_adjust: a winter coat rack, ankle boots, and mannequins dressed in wide-leg trousers wait beside the rear curtain

inserts.action: rolls a model nuclear power station from backstage to the footlights and points from its cooling towers toward a row of dim household bulbs

variations.scene_adjust: a model power station, dim bulbs, empty fuel canisters, and a household radiator fill the prop cart

inserts.action: emerges from the rear curtain carrying a film reel, pauses under the footlights with renewed confidence, and lifts the reel toward the seats

variations.scene_adjust: a movie camera, film reel, director's chair, and award statuette occupy the front of the stage

inserts.action: repeatedly rolls a workbench clock from the rear curtain to the front strip, then opens both hands toward a model of France in determined debate

variations.scene_adjust: a clock with prominent hands, an hourglass, a factory punch clock, and a raised model of France sit on the returning cart

anchor.semantic_hook: Making a balance sheet or assessment is staged as physically constructing a two-pan balance and placing the evidence from a situation on its opposing sides.
anchor.setting: An empty assessment workshop contains sorting trays, unmarked counters, measuring tools, storage drawers, and a central assembly bench. Above the bench, a completed two-pan balance floats without any support, ready to receive favorable and unfavorable evidence. This unsupported working balance is the workshop's sole impossible feature.
anchor.absurd_element: a completed two-pan balance floating unsupported above its assembly bench

inserts.action: places trophies and completed task tokens into one pan, then studies the other pan with a sober year-end expression
loads broken tools and unfinished task pieces into the opposite pan and steadies the swaying beam

variations.scene_adjust: completed task tokens and small trophies face broken tools and unfinished pieces in the two pans

inserts.action: sits beside Emmanuel, places a shared house key and a worn travel keepsake into one pan, and looks toward him thoughtfully
places two household cups and a repaired picture frame into the other pan, then meets Catherine's gaze with gentle concern

variations.scene_adjust: two chairs, shared household objects, a ring, and a house key turn the assembly bench into a relationship review

inserts.action: wears a doctor's coat, listens to Emmanuel's chest with a stethoscope, and gestures toward prepared examination instruments
sits upright in the patient chair, rolls up one sleeve, and watches the doctor's examination with attentive concern

variations.scene_adjust: a patient chair, stethoscope, medical scan images, sample vials, and pressure cuff surround the balance

inserts.action: sorts a camera, calculator, drafting compass, and presentation remote between the pans while considering a new career path

variations.scene_adjust: tools from several professions and a packed office box cover the assessment bench

inserts.action: fits the completed sections of a project model together and places them carefully into the first pan
gathers the remaining project pieces into the second pan and leans in to compare the initial result

variations.scene_adjust: a partly completed project model, component trays, and an early prototype occupy the meeting bench

inserts.action: sorts household purchase tokens into expense trays and points toward the heaviest coin stack with a questioning frown
removes a luxury purchase token from one pan and transfers the saved coins into a small glass jar

variations.scene_adjust: household purchase tokens, coin stacks, a savings jar, and a ring of moon-phase counters mark the monthly expense review

anchor.semantic_hook: Half fig and half raisin is staged as a single fruit divided exactly between a fresh fig half and a dried grape half.
anchor.setting: An empty produce appraisal room contains a tasting counter, two shallow bowls, a small balance, market baskets, and a central fruit stand. On the stand rests one enormous fruit fused cleanly from half a fig and half a raisin. This fused two-fruit specimen is the room's sole impossible feature.
anchor.absurd_element: one enormous fruit fused from half a fig and half a raisin

inserts.action: leaves an interview chair holding an appealing office key in one hand and a very small stack of salary coins in the other, her face caught between pleasure and disappointment

variations.scene_adjust: an interview chair, an office key, a smart briefcase, and a very small salary coin stack flank the fruit stand

inserts.action: raises two acting trophies approvingly, lowers a bundle of loose screenplay pages with the other hand, and gives an uncertain sideways grimace

variations.scene_adjust: a film projector, acting trophies, an unmarked screenplay bundle, and a disappointed review token sit on the tasting counter

inserts.action: offers Timothee a house key and gestures toward a tower of packed moving boxes with cautious optimism
accepts the key while hugging a familiar household lamp, one eyebrow raised and his mouth held in a reluctant half-smile

variations.scene_adjust: packed moving boxes, a house key, a rolled rug, and a familiar lamp surround the fruit stand

inserts.action: holds a sun hat appreciatively while pressing an ear protector against one ear and glancing toward the hotel bell in annoyance
stands beside open luggage with a pleased suntan and winces at a cluster of rattling hotel carts

variations.scene_adjust: sun hats and beach gear share the counter with ear protectors, luggage, a hotel bell, and rattling service carts

inserts.action: turns toward Timothee with one corner of her mouth raised and the other held flat, hands hovering indecisively near the two fruit bowls
faces Marion across the counter and studies her hesitant half-smile with patient curiosity

variations.scene_adjust: the two shallow fruit bowls stand directly between the hesitant speaker and listener

inserts.action: sets a completed project model beside an overflowing hourglass, points proudly at the finished structure, and grimaces at the spent sand
checks the completed model, then lifts the late hourglass with a measured expression of approval and frustration

variations.scene_adjust: a completed project model and achievement tokens sit beside an hourglass overflowing far past its deadline tray

anchor.semantic_hook: Agreeing to say is staged as tuning two separate speaking horns until they produce one perfectly unified utterance.
anchor.setting: An empty consensus chamber contains two facing lecterns, paired speaking horns, acoustic panels, tuning pegs, and a round discussion table. The separate horns merge their sound into one solid suspended ripple above the table. This single shared ripple formed from two voices is the chamber's sole impossible feature.
anchor.absurd_element: two separate speaking horns merging their sound into one solid suspended ripple

inserts.action: examines a heat-cracked globe and shrinking ice model, then points firmly toward a tray of urgent climate tools
stands at the opposite lectern, studies the same globe, and answers with an emphatic nod and matching open-palm gesture

variations.scene_adjust: a heat-cracked globe, shrinking ice, a wind turbine model, and a dial thermometer cover the discussion table

inserts.action: holds a film reel close to her chest, gestures enthusiastically toward an award statuette, and smiles at Emmanuel
raises both thumbs beside the projector and nods vigorously toward the same award statuette

variations.scene_adjust: a home film projector, comfortable paired chairs, a film reel, and an award statuette turn the chamber into a family screening review

inserts.action: tries to align several tangled project components, pauses, and presses both hands to her temples
holds an overfilled task tray beside the tangled model and gives Christine a weary confirming nod

variations.scene_adjust: a tangled project model, too many component trays, overlapping gears, and unused tools crowd the discussion table

inserts.action: wears a doctor's coat, arranges eight moon-shaped sleep counters beside a pillow, and points firmly toward the prepared bed
wears a doctor's coat, checks a clock with prominent hands, and nods in exact agreement toward the eight counters

variations.scene_adjust: a prepared bed, eight moon-shaped counters, a pillow, and a clock with prominent hands occupy the chamber

inserts.action: tastes a carefully plated dish, closes her eyes in delight, and points approvingly toward the restaurant kitchen
tastes the matching dish, lifts an empty plate in praise, and gives Christine an enthusiastic nod

variations.scene_adjust: paired tasting plates, polished cutlery, a serving dome, and a view into a well-equipped unoccupied restaurant kitchen fill the table

inserts.action: compares a damaged earlier model with its repaired current version and relaxes into a satisfied smile
sets the final repaired piece in place, looks from the earlier model to the current one, and extends his hand in agreement

variations.scene_adjust: a damaged earlier model and a repaired current model stand side by side after a long discussion

anchor.semantic_hook: Hardening the tone is staged as spoken sound leaving a horn and physically turning from soft ripples into rigid stone rings.
anchor.setting: An empty address room contains a lectern, a speaking horn, meeting chairs, a negotiation table, and a row of acoustic panels. The sound ripples emerging from the horn solidify in midair into thick stone rings above the table. These airborne stone sound rings are the room's sole impossible feature.
anchor.absurd_element: spoken sound ripples solidifying in midair into thick stone rings

inserts.action: stands behind the negotiation table with a closed school report folder, points sternly toward neglected study books, and tightens his jaw

variations.scene_adjust: a closed school report folder, neglected study books, a game controller, and a parent chair occupy the table

inserts.action: stands at the lectern, lifts a false-bottom cash box into view, and brings one fist down beside rows of hidden coins

variations.scene_adjust: false-bottom cash boxes, hidden coin stacks, tax tokens, and sealed evidence trays cover the negotiation table

inserts.action: stands at the head of the meeting table, points sharply from a clock with late-positioned hands to several empty team chairs, and holds a firm unsmiling posture

variations.scene_adjust: a clock with late-positioned hands, abandoned coffee cups, and several empty team chairs establish repeated lateness

inserts.action: stands beside a classroom desk, presses one palm downward for silence, and fixes the scattered seats with a severe stare
closes a classroom door, gathers tossed notes from the floor, and folds his arms beside Christine

variations.scene_adjust: classroom desks, toppled pencil cases, tossed paper balls, and displaced chairs show the aftermath of constant chatter

inserts.action: grips both sides of the lectern during his speech, leans toward the speaking horn, and raises one clenched fist in a forceful response

variations.scene_adjust: a presidential lectern, press microphones without emblems, and a crumpled provocation token occupy the address area

inserts.action: wears a coach's tracksuit, blows a whistle beside the bench, and points forcefully from the resting football toward the pitch entrance

variations.scene_adjust: a football, water bottles, a tactics board without markings, and a halftime bench replace the negotiation furniture

anchor.semantic_hook: Having one's lot or share is staged as receiving a physically allotted tray containing the particular burdens and surprises assigned to a situation.
anchor.setting: An empty allocation depot contains equal floor bays, parcel trays, sorting chutes, storage cages, and a central collection counter. One modest tray unfolds beyond its own edges into a room-sized allotment while all other trays remain ordinary. This space-defying allotted tray is the depot's sole impossible feature.
anchor.absurd_element: one modest parcel tray unfolding into a room-sized allotment beyond its edges

inserts.action: kneels inside the allotted tray, untangles project cables, frees a jammed gear, and reaches determinedly toward the unfinished model

variations.scene_adjust: an unfinished professional project model, tangled cables, jammed gears, and missing components fill the allotment

inserts.action: wears a student backpack, compares a tiny dormitory key with rows of unavailable apartment models, and rubs his forehead anxiously

variations.scene_adjust: apartment models with closed doors, one tiny dormitory key, moving boxes, and application tokens fill the allotment

inserts.action: opens a travel case beside a boot-shaped model of Italy, lifts a delightful festival mask, and discovers a broken suitcase wheel underneath

variations.scene_adjust: a boot-shaped model of Italy, travel case, festival mask, beautiful keepsake, and broken suitcase wheel share the allotted tray

inserts.action: paints eagerly at an easel, glances at an almost empty coin pouch and vacant gallery hooks, then returns to the canvas with excitement

variations.scene_adjust: an easel, unfinished canvas, sculpting tools, an almost empty coin pouch, and vacant gallery hooks fill the allotment

inserts.action: leans over a miniature city grid, tries to separate tightly packed model cars, and stares at the blocked intersections in frustration

variations.scene_adjust: a dense miniature city, tightly packed model cars, stalled buses, and blocked intersections occupy the allotted tray

inserts.action: stands beneath stacked task trays with a new office key in hand, steadies the responsibilities on his shoulders, and smiles with determined readiness

variations.scene_adjust: a new office key, stacked task trays, ringing desk phones, project tools, and appointment clocks crowd the allotment

anchor.semantic_hook: The literal hyphen is staged as a short horizontal joining bar that physically connects two otherwise separated sides.
anchor.setting: An empty connection hall contains two distant raised terraces, paired stairways, object plinths, and a deep gap between the halves. A tiny horizontal joining bar stretches across the entire gap and supports a broad passage despite its delicate size. This distance-spanning short bar is the hall's sole impossible feature.
anchor.absurd_element: a tiny horizontal joining bar stretching across a vast gap and supporting a broad passage

inserts.action: plays a violin on one terrace and steps onto the joining bar while listening toward Timothee's different instrument
plays a hand drum on the opposite terrace and matches Catherine's rhythm across the connecting passage

variations.scene_adjust: a violin and orchestral case occupy one cultural terrace while a hand drum and wooden flute occupy the other

inserts.action: sits at the midpoint of the joining bar, gathers two ends of a family quilt in her lap, and beckons Timothee closer with warm authority
carries one family keepsake box from a distant terrace and reaches gratefully for Catherine's hand

variations.scene_adjust: separated household keepsake boxes and the two ends of a family quilt meet at the joining bar

inserts.action: approaches from the youth activity terrace carrying a football and reaches across the midpoint to exchange it for a gardening tool
approaches from the neighborhood garden terrace with a watering can and welcomes Timothee at the midpoint

variations.scene_adjust: sports gear and study materials occupy one terrace while gardening tools, knitting, and a comfortable chair occupy the other

inserts.action: holds an open tablet with a blank screen on one side of a globe model and extends a network cable across the joining bar
connects the cable to a blank laptop on the opposite side and waves toward Catherine across the global display

variations.scene_adjust: two halves of a globe model, blank computer screens, routers without emblems, and a network cable occupy the terraces

inserts.action: carries a thick closed history volume from the terrace of old tools and extends it across the joining bar
receives the history volume beside modern devices and studies an antique object resting beside its open pages

variations.scene_adjust: antique tools and weathered objects occupy one terrace while modern devices and current household objects occupy the other

inserts.action: stands at the midpoint with a project model, carries a technical component toward the client sample case, and gestures calmly between both terraces
waits at the client terrace with a sample case, receives the finished component, and nods appreciatively toward the distant technical bench

variations.scene_adjust: computers and mechanical components occupy the technical terrace while product samples and client chairs occupy the other

anchor.semantic_hook: Being in the line of sight is staged as placing a goal directly along the aiming path between an optical sight and a distant target.
anchor.setting: An empty observation range contains a tripod-mounted optical sight, concentric target discs, distance markers without numerals, equipment benches, and a far objective plinth. A solid straight beam extends from the sight through open air and touches the exact center of the distant objective. This touchable airborne sight line is the range's sole impossible feature.
anchor.absurd_element: a solid touchable sight line extending through open air to the exact center of an objective

inserts.action: wears a football kit, places the victory ball beside the optical sight, and fixes his gaze along the beam toward a championship trophy

variations.scene_adjust: a championship trophy stands on the far plinth while a football and victory medal rest beside the optical sight

inserts.action: leans intently over a project model, adjusts the optical sight toward a deadline clock, and holds his concentration despite scattered tools

variations.scene_adjust: a nearly finished project model and scattered tools surround the sight while a clock with urgent-positioned hands occupies the far plinth

inserts.action: stands on the far objective plinth in a minister's suit, grips a policy folder, and glances uneasily back along the beam toward the observation benches

variations.scene_adjust: union meeting chairs, raised demand placards without markings, and an official policy folder frame the targeted minister

inserts.action: studies at the equipment bench with several open diagram books, pauses to adjust the sight toward an entrance arch, and returns immediately to his exercises

variations.scene_adjust: study books filled only with diagrams, pencils, examination tokens, and a distant college entrance arch define the student's goal

inserts.action: wears business attire, guides miniature cargo crates along the solid sight line, and studies a raised map of Europe with confident focus

variations.scene_adjust: miniature cargo crates, a cargo ship model, trade tokens, and a raised map of Europe occupy the route to the objective

inserts.action: wears an environmental field vest and protective mask, adjusts the sight toward smoking factory models, and points to a jar of dirty air with urgent resolve

variations.scene_adjust: smoking factory models, dark air filters, oil drums without emblems, and sealed air-sample jars occupy the far objective area

anchor.semantic_hook: Becoming the object of an action is staged as placing one concrete item at the center while every relevant instrument directs its activity toward it.
anchor.setting: An empty examination rotunda contains a central pedestal, surrounding worktables, movable lamps, viewing instruments, discussion chairs, and evidence trays. Every surrounding instrument leaves its table and orbits one ordinary object above the pedestal. This unsupported orbit of attention around a single object is the rotunda's sole impossible feature.
anchor.absurd_element: every examination instrument orbiting unsupported around one ordinary central object

inserts.action: sets a thick bill dossier of unmarked pages on the central pedestal and gestures around the many parliamentary discussion chairs

variations.scene_adjust: a thick dossier of unmarked pages, debate microphones without emblems, and semicircular parliamentary chairs surround the pedestal

inserts.action: sits tensely in the central examination chair, holds her hands together, and watches forensic instruments inspect the evidence around her

variations.scene_adjust: a suspect chair, fingerprint tools, sealed evidence bags, a camera, and a magnifying lens occupy the investigation rotunda

inserts.action: pulls a fitted cover from a new car model on the pedestal and turns toward an arc of waiting cameras with a formal presenting gesture

variations.scene_adjust: a covered new car model, presentation turntable, cameras without emblems, and empty press chairs surround the pedestal

inserts.action: opens a thick geography volume at the pedestal and points to a globe, melting ice model, and thermometer arranged across one complete section

variations.scene_adjust: an open volume containing only maps and diagrams supports a globe, melting ice model, and dial thermometer

inserts.action: carefully positions a sculpture on the central pedestal, checks a nearby framed painting, and opens both hands toward the temporary gallery display

variations.scene_adjust: framed paintings, a central sculpture, gallery barriers, and the Louvre's recognizable interior architecture form a temporary exhibition

inserts.action: stands behind the pedestal holding a sealed decision folder, braces against a ring of sharply pointed microphones, and faces the empty employee chairs with resolve

variations.scene_adjust: a sealed decision folder, sharply angled microphones, discarded employee access cards, and office chairs surround the pedestal

anchor.semantic_hook: Starting up again with greater force is staged as a paused activity passing through a restart mechanism and immediately resuming at amplified intensity.
anchor.setting: An empty restart-testing hall contains a halted conveyor, a large reset crank, activity bays, storage racks, and a reinforced observation bench. Beyond the crank, one resumed motion expands into a version many times stronger than it was before the pause. This force-multiplying restart mechanism is the hall's sole impossible feature.
anchor.absurd_element: a reset crank that multiplies the force of any motion resumed beyond it

inserts.action: steps out after a brief dry pause, snaps open an umbrella, and hunches beneath the suddenly intensified indoor rain
turns the reset crank beside the rain bay and recoils from the renewed downpour

variations.scene_adjust: a rain-testing rig releases a few lingering drops before the crank and a pounding downpour beyond it

inserts.action: starts a road drill beside a morning clock and leans his full weight into the renewed work
stands at the observation bench with hands pressed over her ears as the roadwork resumes

variations.scene_adjust: road barriers without markings, a drill, broken pavement, and a morning clock with prominent hands occupy the activity bay

inserts.action: sits upright on a recovery cot during the night, coughs forcefully into a tissue, and reaches for a glass of water in dismay
stands beside the cot holding a thermometer and offers the water with worried attention

variations.scene_adjust: a recovery cot, bedside lamp, tissues, water glass, and thermometer occupy the night treatment bay

inserts.action: leans across an office table, points angrily at a scattered project model, and resumes arguing the moment the manager's chair is empty
stands on the opposite side, throws both hands outward, and answers with equal frustration

variations.scene_adjust: a suddenly empty manager's chair, scattered project components, and two opposing office seats occupy the activity bay

inserts.action: returns with a vacation suitcase, freezes beside an executive chair, and stares uneasily at a sealed resignation envelope
leans across the office divider with one hand beside her mouth and gestures urgently toward the resignation envelope

variations.scene_adjust: a vacation suitcase, executive chair, sealed resignation envelope, and office divider fill the rumor activity bay

inserts.action: holds a nearly empty grocery basket, compares it with a newly enlarged stack of coins, and frowns at the renewed increase
turns the reset crank beside rising coin stacks and watches the affordable goods recede with alarm

variations.scene_adjust: grocery baskets contain fewer goods beyond the restart point while the required coin stacks rise sharply

anchor.semantic_hook: A before and an after are staged as two physical halves of one timeline room divided by a decisive central threshold.
anchor.setting: An empty transition hall contains a central threshold, matched object plinths, a continuous floor path, and parallel display bays on either side. Every object exists simultaneously in its earlier condition on one side and its permanently changed condition on the other. This coexistence of two ages of the same objects is the hall's sole impossible feature.
anchor.absurd_element: two different ages of every object existing simultaneously on opposite sides of one threshold

inserts.action: steps across the threshold carrying a smartphone, leaves a fixed telephone and paper map behind, and connects with several blank-screen devices ahead

variations.scene_adjust: a fixed telephone, paper map, and isolated desk occupy the earlier side while interconnected smartphones occupy the changed side

inserts.action: crosses from a low workstation to a manager's desk, accepts a new office key, and straightens with fresh professional confidence

variations.scene_adjust: an ordinary workstation and small toolbox precede the threshold while a manager's desk, office key, and project portfolio follow it

inserts.action: stands tenderly at the threshold, sets down two adult travel bags, and reaches toward a prepared cradle holding tiny socks

variations.scene_adjust: two adult travel bags and paired leisure gear occupy the earlier side while a cradle, feeding bottle, and tiny socks fill the family side

inserts.action: steps away from an unused sofa, ties his running shoes at the threshold, and reaches energetically toward exercise equipment on the changed side

variations.scene_adjust: an unused sofa and dusty shoes precede the threshold while a running track, dumbbells, water bottle, and worn training shoes follow it

inserts.action: returns across the threshold with a travel pack and water-purification equipment, then pauses to study his discarded carefree possessions with a newly purposeful expression

variations.scene_adjust: carefree entertainment gear occupies the earlier young-adult side while a travel pack, medical supplies, and water-purification tools occupy the humanitarian side

inserts.action: carries a small shop model across the threshold, closes its public counter, and opens a compact delivery hatch with determined caution

variations.scene_adjust: a traditional open shop counter precedes the threshold while delivery crates, protective screens, and a compact collection hatch follow it

anchor.semantic_hook: Making the bullseye called the fly is staged as directing each attempt into the exact center of a target occupied by a fly.
anchor.setting: An empty precision range contains a throwing line, equipment rack, concentric target, retrieval lane, and impact bench. A fly the size of the entire target sits motionless at the exact center of its rings. This target-sized fly occupying the bullseye is the range's sole impossible feature.
anchor.absurd_element: a fly the size of the entire target sitting at the exact center of the bullseye

inserts.action: launches a sleek advertising display toward the center and watches it land squarely beneath the giant fly with confident satisfaction
stands beside youthful clothing and a smartphone, reacts with immediate enthusiasm, and reaches eagerly for the advertised product

variations.scene_adjust: a sleek advertising display without markings, youthful clothing, smartphones, and product samples occupy the range

inserts.action: stands at a debate lectern, points decisively from a budget coin stack to the exact target center, and holds her opponent's gaze
stands at the opposing lectern, recoils from the precise budget point, and looks down at his scattered coins

variations.scene_adjust: two debate lecterns without emblems, budget coin stacks, and accounting tokens flank the throwing line

inserts.action: operates a small film projector, arranges a few simple story props along the target lane, and watches Marion's reaction attentively
sits at the impact bench, presses one hand to her heart, and wipes away a tear while smiling at the simple scene

variations.scene_adjust: a small film projector, a family keepsake, two simple chairs, and a modest story set occupy the precision range

inserts.action: drives a football through a small goal and directly into the target center, then follows through with practiced certainty

variations.scene_adjust: a strip of football turf and a small goal align the ball's path with the central target

inserts.action: offers a carefully wrapped gift box across the throwing line and watches Timothee's face with hopeful anticipation
opens the gift, lifts the perfect object with both hands, and breaks into an unmistakably delighted grin

variations.scene_adjust: a carefully wrapped gift box, ribbon, and selection of rejected gift objects occupy the impact bench

inserts.action: delivers the punch line with a precise hand gesture toward the target center and pauses with a mischievous grin
bursts into laughter on the audience bench, doubles forward, and claps both hands in delighted reaction

variations.scene_adjust: a small performance microphone without emblems and an audience bench occupy the range beside the central target
